verdict.rationale: Smithery gives each published server a dedicated page for discovering and trying it (smithery-docs-23), and the CLI can search the registry and find tools by name or intent (smithery-gh-1, smithery-gh-2). It also collects tool and schema metadata through automatic scanning or a static server card (smithery-docs-11, smithery-docs-16), distinguishes local stdio bundles from hosted URL servers (smithery-docs-10, smithery-docs-9), and community scans show tool descriptions are readable before connecting (smithery-comm-1). However, nothing explicitly documents a pre-connection view showing tools, input schemas, transport and hosting attributes together. missing for 10: explicit documentation that server pages or the API display tool lists with input schemas before connecting, explicit display of transport and hosting attributes, hands-on corroboration of the inspection UI or API.
